decision_contract.primary: selected numeric_D0 minus mask_D0 paired absolute price-error improvement; positive means numeric is better
decision_contract.gain_definition: 100 * (1 - numeric_MAE / comparator_MAE), on identical rows; positive means improvement
decision_contract.stress: selected numeric_D1 versus mask_D1; never choose a delay using OOS

decision_precedence.if: any identity, row/target equality, source-time or payload verification fails
decision_precedence.then: INVALID; no scientific inference or further fitting until the failed check is resolved

decision_precedence.if: D0 and D1 paired improvement intervals both have lower bound > 0 for block 20 and 60, and D0 Naive point gain >= 5% and all-origin direction >= 53%
decision_precedence.then: CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE; lock the recipe for real availability and prospective validation; not release eligible

decision_precedence.if: both numeric arms have Naive gain interval upper bound < 5% for block 20 and 60
decision_precedence.then: FIXED_RECIPE_BELOW_PRACTICAL_GOAL; retain Naive and stop enlarging this fixed program

decision_precedence.if: D0 and D1 paired improvement lower bounds > 0 for block 20 and 60, but practical point thresholds fail
decision_precedence.then: INCREMENTAL_BUT_BELOW_GOAL; record the contribution, no automatic model/source search

decision_precedence.if: D0 shows improvement but D1 does not support it, or intervals do not distinguish a useful effect
decision_precedence.then: INCONCLUSIVE_OR_DELAY_SENSITIVE; no post-hoc delay choice or automatic extra fits
INCONCLUSIVE; report uncertainty without universal no-signal claims

limitations: Five reused years cannot satisfy the unchanged 6/8 full-year release rule.
Assumed availability is not verified publication or vintage availability.
Zero selected shrinkage and [0,0] differences test the selected rule, not absence of source information.
Raw, active-rate, annual, trimmed and age-subset results remain diagnostics, never substitutes for the primary.
Intervals do not account for every historical human/model/source selection.

planned_coverage: 2019-2023; 1254 common origins per arm; four arms
